Lauren — dropping in here with the technical mapping you asked for. Notes below and attached a short throughput-plan.md + latency-profile.png for your ops team.

- Rate limits: with a 275M monthly commit we recommend configuring per-route concurrency quotas and a short per-second token cap for the public inference endpoint. Practical suggestion: 220 tps (tokens/sec) sustained per model shard with a 2x short-burst allowance for 60s windows. That maps to predictable tail latency while allowing short spikes.
- Overage behavior: default behavior is per-token billing at the overage unit rate. For renewals where we expect growth, we usually add a soft-guard (pre-approval threshold) at +10% of commit to trigger an alert + account manager approval before automatic billing. This is what the proposal's "soft-guard" line item does.
- Graceband semantics: apply to billing start date (i.e., we start the commit on renewal date but invoice dates can be deferred into the grace week if a PO is pending). This prevents immediate overage for timing gaps.

Impacts and ops checklist:
1) Implement per-route caps in Redwood Console (we can pre-provision with the new tier).
2) Enable prefix cache for your top-10 query patterns — will reduce effective token usage by up to ~18% based on your logs.
3) We'll add rate-limit headers to responses so Storify can surface metrics in your observability dashboards.

Attachments: throughput-plan.md, latency-profile.png
